subject: physics
topic: Pressure in solids, liquids and gases; Archimedes' principle and flotation

kept.q: A nurse at a clinic in Enugu presses the tip of a hypodermic needle against a patient's skin. The tip has a cross-sectional area of 0.0005 cm^2, and the nurse applies a force of 2.5 N. Calculate the pressure exerted by the needle tip on the skin.
kept.explanation: First convert area to m^2: 0.0005 cm^2 = 0.0005 x 10^-4 m^2 = 5 x 10^-8 m^2. Pressure = Force / Area = 2.5 / (5 x 10^-8) = 5 x 10^7 N/m^2. The tiny area of the sharp needle tip makes the pressure very large even though the force is small.
kept.pidgin: Make we change the area go m^2 first: 0.0005 cm^2 = 5 x 10^-8 m^2. Pressure = Force / Area = 2.5 / (5 x 10^-8) = 5 x 10^7 N/m^2. Na why sharp needle fit press hard enter skin even though the force small.

kept.q: A barometer tube contains a column of mercury 76 cm high. Calculate the pressure exerted by this column of mercury. (Density of mercury = 13600 kg/m^3, g = 10 m/s^2)
kept.explanation: Pressure in a liquid column is given by P = h x density x g. First change 76 cm to 0.76 m, then P = 0.76 x 13600 x 10 = 103360 N/m^2, which is about 1.034 x 10^5 N/m^2. This is the usual value of atmospheric pressure measured by a mercury barometer.
kept.pidgin: Pressure for liquid column be P = h x density x g. Change 76 cm go 0.76 m, then P = 0.76 x 13600 x 10 = 103360 N/m^2, wey be around 1.034 x 10^5 N/m^2. Na dis kain value dem dey get for mercury barometer wey dey show atmospheric pressure.

kept.q: A metal block of mass 450 g and volume 60 cm^3 is suspended from a spring balance and lowered until it is completely submerged in a liquid of density 800 kg/m^3. Calculate the new reading on the spring balance. (g = 10 m/s^2)
kept.explanation: Weight in air = mg = 0.45 x 10 = 4.5 N. Upthrust = density of liquid x volume x g = 800 x (60 x 10^-6) x 10 = 0.48 N. Apparent weight = weight in air minus upthrust = 4.5 - 0.48 = 4.02 N, which is what the spring balance reads.
kept.pidgin: Weight for air = mg = 0.45 x 10 = 4.5 N. Upthrust = density of liquid x volume x g = 800 x (60 x 10^-6) x 10 = 0.48 N. Apparent weight = 4.5 - 0.48 = 4.02 N, na im spring balance go show.

kept.q: A cube of wax floats in water with one-fifth of its volume above the surface. If the same cube is placed in a sample of groundnut oil of density 880 kg/m^3, what fraction of its volume will now float above the oil's surface? (Density of water = 1000 kg/m^3)
kept.explanation: In water, 4/5 of the wax is submerged, so density of wax = (4/5) x 1000 = 800 kg/m^3. In oil, the submerged fraction equals density of wax divided by density of oil = 800/880 = 10/11, so the fraction above the oil surface is 1 - 10/11 = 1/11.
kept.pidgin: For water, 4/5 of the wax dey inside, so density of wax = (4/5) x 1000 = 800 kg/m^3. For oil, the part wey dey inside na density of wax divide by density of oil = 800/880 = 10/11, so the part wey dey outside na 1 - 10/11 = 1/11.
